in_marathi.name: Murugesh
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे God of War and Love
in_marathi.long_meaning: Murugesh हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Murugesh, also known as Kartikeya, is the Hindu god of war, knowledge, and love. He is the son of Shiva and Parvati. He holds a vel (a powerful weapon) and a peacock as his mount. He is considered the god of fertility and is often worshiped to ensure the safe delivery of babies.

in_bengali.long_meaning: Murugesh একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। Murugesh, also known as Kartikeya, is the Hindu god of war, knowledge, and love.
